children: Alimentation Couche-Tard has agreed to acquire certain assets in Quebec and Ontario from Irving Oil.

The Canadian convenience store operator on Friday said it will acquire 50 retail sites already operated by Couche-Tard under the Quebec Alliance between the two companies, as well as two retail sites in Ontario.
The deal also covers fuel supply to 71 retail sites that Couche-Tard owns and operates in Quebec, as well as 18 cardlock sites.

"These are markets and customers we know well," said Senior Vice President of Operations Stephane Trudel. "The transaction would support our continued investment in the everyday convenience experience we offer our customers."
